name: cbor-ld-stream-demo
description: Streaming LWS notifications as NDJSON-LD and CBOR-LD CBOR Sequences

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @lws-stream/server && npm run typecheck -w @lws-stream/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lws-stream/server && npm run test -w @lws-stream/client
